title: Flow Front Moving Through Vegetation
place: Flow front southeast of Puʻu ʻŌʻō, Kīlauea East Rift Zone, Hawaiʻi
audio: natural (crackling/fire, kept AAC) - not listened to closely
notes: Close ground view of a channelized 'a'a flow front: a dark rubbly wall of lava with glowing orange base slopes from upper-left to lower-right; shrubs and small trees at the right edge (x~0.7-1.0) catch fire with tall flames (0-1 s, 9-12 s strongest at x~0.85,y~0.4). Glowing blocks tumble off the front throughout. Small white USGS bug bottom-left (x~0.0-0.12,y~0.95) - crop away. Source 1000x562 upscaled to 1920x1080 (soft). Best shot A 2.0-4.6 (front creeping, glowing base); shot B 9.0-11.6 (bushes go up in flames, x~0.8).
fact_en: The leading tip of the flow is burning vegetation in a kīpuka.
